about: Which sectors each department regulates, funds, or buys from. Used by the web page to outline trades in sectors an official's own department oversees. This is a judgment call, not an official list: edit it freely. 'match' is text found in the official's role. 'tickers' flags specific companies outside those sectors (for example a major contractor).

departments.name: State
departments.why: Licenses arms exports and approves foreign military sales.

departments.name: Treasury
departments.why: Oversees banking regulators, sanctions, and financial markets policy.

departments.name: Defense
departments.why: The largest buyer of weapons, aircraft and defense technology.

departments.name: Justice
departments.why: Antitrust and criminal enforcement reach every sector; add tickers for companies with specific DOJ matters.

departments.name: Interior
departments.why: Leases federal land and offshore waters for drilling, mining and power projects.

departments.name: Agriculture
departments.why: Regulates and subsidizes farming, meat and food production.

departments.name: Commerce
departments.why: Runs export controls, CHIPS Act funding and spectrum policy.

departments.name: Labor
departments.why: Workplace rules apply economy-wide; add tickers for companies with specific Labor Department matters.

departments.name: Health and Human Services
departments.why: FDA approvals, Medicare and Medicaid payments, and food and tobacco regulation.

departments.name: Housing and Urban Development
departments.why: FHA mortgage insurance, housing finance and public housing.

departments.name: Transportation
departments.why: Regulates airlines, railroads, trucking and vehicle safety, and certifies aircraft.

departments.name: Energy
departments.why: Energy policy, LNG export approvals, nuclear and grid programs.

departments.name: Education
departments.why: Student aid and oversight of for-profit schools.

departments.name: Veterans Affairs
departments.why: Runs the largest US health system and buys drugs and devices at scale.

departments.name: Homeland Security
departments.why: Border, aviation and cybersecurity contracts; airport and port security.
